descriptions.rgb: In this downward-angled egocentric view of an indoor room with a tiled floor, the seated camera wearer holds a large stainless-steel basin on their lap about 0.4 to 0.5 metres below the camera, with a small yellow plastic basket of white cotton resting on the floor to the lower left at about 0.7 metres and a dark wooden chair positioned ahead to the upper right at roughly 1.2 to 1.5 metres. Inside the basin are a pile of red-and-white cotton wicks in the lower-left portion and a small round metal cup containing dark liquid in the upper-right portion, all within easy arm's reach of the camera wearer. The camera wearer's left hand holds a bundle of white cotton above the left edge of the basin at about 0.35 metres from the viewpoint across all five frames, while their right hand reaches from the lower right into the basin to touch and dip fingers into the small metal cup from the second frame onward. A second person wearing a black-and-white striped garment stands immediately in front of and slightly to the left of the camera wearer at approximately 0.5 to 0.7 metres, facing toward the camera wearer and the basin; this person's head and upper torso are cropped out of the top of the frame, so whether they are looking at the camera wearer is not visible. In the first frame, the standing person's right hand reaches down within arm's reach to the top edge of the basin holding a small metal tumbler near the small cup, then lifts the tumbler upward and partially out of the upper frame in the second and third frames while slightly shifting their lower body, before lowering the tumbler back down to the upper rim of the basin in the fourth and fifth frames. Throughout the sequence, the camera wearer's hands and the standing person's arm and garment partially occlude parts of the basin, the small cup, and the colourful circular floor mat beneath the standing person's feet.
